def convertFileToList(thisFile):
  # opening the file in read mode
  myFile = open(thisFile, "r")
  # reading the file
  data = myFile.read()
  # replacing end splitting the text
  # when newline ('\n') is seen.
  dataIntoList = data.split("\n")
  # Remove empty strings
  while("" in dataIntoList):
    dataIntoList.remove("")
  print(dataIntoList)
  myFile.close()
  return dataIntoList

def make_results_dir(pathToWD):
    # Start in main directory
    os.chdir(pathToWD)
    current_time = datetime.datetime.now()
    num_run_dir = 'Results_'  + str(current_time.month) + str(current_time.day) + str('_') + str(current_time.hour) + str(current_time.minute) + str(current_time.second) # Create directory with timedate
    pathToResults = num_run_dir
    try:
        os.mkdir(pathToResults)
    except OSError:
        print ("Creation of the directory %s failed" % pathToResults)
    else:
        print ("Successfully created the directory %s " % pathToResults)
    os.chdir(num_run_dir) # Switch to the results directory
    print('Path to Results =', pathToResults)
    return  pathToResults

### This will print out all of the tags (fields) in the file, along with their corresponding values. The tag names are based on the CIF dictionary that was used to create the file, so they can vary quite a bit from file to file.

from pymatgen.core.structure import Structure

# Load the structure from a CIF file
structure = Structure.from_file('/content/drive/MyDrive/work_cgcnn/hMOF-165.cif')

# Print the formula of the structure
print('Formula:', structure.formula)

# Print the space group
print('Space group:', structure.get_space_group_info())

# Print the unit cell parameters
print('Lattice parameters:')
print('  a =', structure.lattice.a)
print('  b =', structure.lattice.b)
print('  c =', structure.lattice.c)
print('  alpha =', structure.lattice.alpha)
print('  beta =', structure.lattice.beta)
print('  gamma =', structure.lattice.gamma)

# Print all atom positions
print('Atom positions:')
for site in structure.sites:
    print('  Atom:', site.species)
    print('  Position:', site.frac_coords)
